notes.title: 10/04 - Demo update
notes.notes:
Level two in a nutshell:

Level Two expands upon the groundwork laid in the first level, providing 15-25 minutes of gameplay. It brings closure to Level One's quests while introducing fresh challenges and discoveries.

Players will encounter new combat mechanics, including armor, shields, and ranged enemies, adding depth to the strategic elements of the game.

Explore the intricate lore and characters of our world through various pathways and interactions, each contributing to the narrative in meaningful ways.

We look forward to hearing your thoughts and experiences as you progress through this next stage of our demo.

Thanks for playing!
The Epictellers Team
